name.zh: 新中式插画 · 古诗山水
name.en: Contemporary Chinese-style Illustration · Landscapes Inspired by Classical Poetry

classification.zh: 新中式装饰山水插画：古诗叙事、青绿朱红设色、细线勾勒、纸本颗粒与长卷式留白
classification.en: Contemporary Chinese-style decorative landscape illustration: classical-poetry narratives, blue-green and vermilion color, fine outlines, paper-like grain and scroll-like open space

summary.zh: 这组图把古诗中的一个瞬间放进狭长画幅：密集树冠围出河道、小径或白墙，视线沿浅色空隙缓缓移动，最后停在独钓、指路、停泊、荷尖蜻蜓或越墙花枝上。它的长处是用“大色块—小叙事—细密纹理”建立远近观看的层次；青绿与朱红最鲜明，蓝灰雪景、桃粉花海和荷塘绿调则证明，同一构图语言可以承载不同季节。作为海报，系列统一、主题易读；作为诗意插图，部分画面的华美与热烈也会减弱诗句中的清寒、怅惘或今昔之感。
summary.en: This group places a moment from a classical Chinese poem within a narrow, elongated frame. Dense canopies surround a river, path or white wall, and the eye moves slowly along pale openings before resting on solitary fishing, a pointing gesture, a moored boat, a dragonfly on a lotus tip or a flowering branch reaching over a wall. Its strength is the progression from large color areas to small narratives to fine texture, creating different experiences at a distance and up close. Blue-green and vermilion are the most striking colors, but blue-gray snow scenes, peach-pink blossom fields and green lotus ponds show how the same compositional language can carry different seasons. As posters, the series is coherent and its subjects are easy to read; as poetic illustrations, the splendor and exuberance of some images can also diminish the chill, melancholy or contrast between past and present in the poems.

recognition.zh: 先找一条连续的浅色空隙，再看它两侧是否由团簇树冠、近黑枝干和细线建筑围合，最后找承担诗意的小动作。与 AS-008 的多种平面纹样相比，本组更依赖完整的山水场景、河路动线和版面留白；与 AS-001 的金箔装饰相比，本组靠墨线、哑光色块和纸本质感组织画面。“新中式插画”用作当代设计的宽泛风格类别，本组进一步归为装饰山水与古诗叙事；青绿朱红、长卷式留白、细线勾勒和纸本颗粒是具体特征。“长卷”形容观看节奏，附件均为竖幅海报，不能据外观认定传统画派、真实木版工艺或 AI 生成。
recognition.en: First find a continuous pale opening; then see whether clustered canopies, near-black branches and finely outlined buildings enclose it on both sides; finally, find the small action carrying the poem’s meaning. Compared with AS-008’s varied flat patterns, this group relies more on complete landscape scenes, rivers and roads as visual routes, and open space in the layout. Compared with AS-001’s gold-leaf decoration, it organizes images with ink lines, matte color areas and paper-like texture. “Contemporary Chinese-style illustration” is used as a broad category of contemporary design; this group is further described as decorative landscape and classical-poetry narrative. Blue-green and vermilion colors, scroll-like open space, fine outlines and paper-like grain are specific features. “Scroll-like” describes the viewing rhythm: all attachments are vertical posters. Appearance alone cannot establish a traditional school of painting, actual woodblock-printing technique or AI generation.

tags: 古诗意境 · 青绿朱红长卷

reuse_focus.zh: 适合把学习者实拍中的河岸、园林、花树、雨后小径或荷塘改绘成有留白的叙事插画。先由她指出一个真实发现或动作，再保留原照片的主路、岸线、人物关系与视角；将现有叶簇概括为大色团，用细线和点叶补结构，最后选择青绿朱红、蓝灰雪景、桃粉或荷塘绿中的一组色彩关系。画面没有的寺庙、舟船和古装人物无需补入。
reuse_focus.en: Suitable for turning the learner’s photographs of riverbanks, gardens, flowering trees, paths after rain or lotus ponds into narrative illustrations with open space. First have her identify a real observation or action, then retain the original photograph’s main path, shoreline, relationships among people and viewpoint. Simplify existing foliage into broad color masses, add structure with fine lines and dotted leaves, and finally select one color relationship: blue-green and vermilion, blue-gray snow, peach pink, or lotus-pond greens. There is no need to add temples, boats or figures in historical dress that are absent from the image.

judgment_note.zh: 八张图片均为用户提供的参考附件，保留原字节、原顺序、完整画幅及已有题字和印章；不是学习者的参赛作品或本次生成改绘。标题依附件上可读诗题记录，柳宗元、杜牧等是画面题注的诗人，不能据此作为插画作者。插画作者、原帖网址、创作年代、真实媒介、制作软件及是否使用 AI 均未核实；不凭文件名、整齐风格或画面质感推定来源。本次只进行视觉品鉴，未做外部归属核验；色盘为视觉近似，提示词为本次归纳的迁移建议。
judgment_note.en: All eight images are user-provided reference attachments. Original bytes, order, full frames, existing inscriptions and seals are retained. They are neither the learner’s competition entries nor AI reinterpretations generated in this task. Titles follow the legible poem titles on the attachments. Liu Zongyuan, Du Mu and the other names in the inscriptions identify poets and must not be treated as the illustrators. The illustrator, original post URL, creation date, actual medium, software and any use of AI are all unverified. Filenames, consistent style and image texture are not grounds for inferring a source. This review only offers visual appreciation; no external attribution verification was performed. Palette colors are visual approximations, and the prompts are style-transfer suggestions derived in this review.

visible_poem_credit.zh: 唐·柳宗元（图中文字；非插画作者署名）
visible_poem_credit.en: Liu Zongyuan · Tang dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 米白江面像一条宽阔的静默通道，蓝灰雪树和近黑枝干从两岸夹入；画中很小的渔舟让“独”有了尺度。最值得学的是少色、低温与疏密反差，雪点只依附枝叶和树冠边缘。图中文字仅呈现部分诗句，不把它当作全诗文本；对学习者的照片改绘，可用原有河面或空地承接这种安静。
focus.en: The ivory river forms a broad, silent passage, with blue-gray snowy trees and near-black branches pressing in from both banks. The tiny fishing boat gives solitude a sense of scale. The key lessons are the limited colors, cool temperature and contrast in density; snow dots cling only to foliage and canopy edges. The image presents only part of the poem, so it must not be treated as the complete poem text. In reinterpreting the learner’s photograph, existing water or open ground can carry this quiet.

visible_poem_credit.zh: 唐·杜牧（图中文字；非插画作者署名）
visible_poem_credit.en: Du Mu · Tang dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 牧童伸手、行人仰望、酒家招幌构成“问路—指路—目的地”的三点关系；红伞把注意力先留在人身上，路面水痕补足细雨。粉花与翠瓦使画面偏明丽，较贴近所题“借问／遥指”的故事瞬间；若想强化清明的湿冷感，可压低花色和整体对比。
focus.en: The herder’s pointing hand, the traveler looking up and the tavern banner form a three-part relationship: asking directions, pointing the way and the destination. The red umbrella first holds attention on the person; wet marks on the road supply the drizzle. Pink blossoms and green roof tiles make the image bright, closer to the inscribed story moment of asking and pointing into the distance. To emphasize the damp chill of Qingming, reduce the intensity of blossom colors and the overall contrast.

visible_poem_credit.en: Liu Yuxi · Tang dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 燕子沿巷道串起上方大宅与下方民居，朱红树冠和青绿瓦面形成有力对照。可读“王谢第”门匾与整饬建筑，使显赫门第仍很醒目；我的品鉴判断是：装饰性鲜明，但“旧时／寻常百姓家”的今昔反差偏弱。若围绕诗意再创作，可通过门庭尺度、日常器物与空间使用变化表现时间。
focus.en: Swallows connect the large residence above with ordinary houses below along the lane, while vermilion canopies contrast strongly with blue-green roofs. The readable “王谢第” (Wang and Xie Residence) plaque and orderly buildings keep the prestigious household conspicuous. My critical judgment is that the decoration is strong but the contrast between former grandeur and ordinary homes today is weak. A new work centered on the poem could express time through changes in entrance scale, everyday objects and how spaces are used.

focus.zh: 河道的折线把下方小船引向右上酒楼；大面积冷青树冠托起朱红树叶、灯笼和窗内暖光，人物剪影给建筑以生活气息。它最适合学习“冷底＋少量暖光”的叙事组织。米纸亮底保留了海报可读性，却淡化了题诗中的烟、水、月与寒意；迁移到雨夜照片时可保留原有暗部，减少亮暖面积。
focus.en: The angular course of the river leads from the small boat below to the tavern at upper right. Broad cool blue-green canopies support vermilion leaves, lanterns and warm window light; human silhouettes give the building a lived-in feeling. This image is especially useful for learning how a cool ground plus a little warm light can organize narrative. The bright ivory paper-like ground keeps the poster legible but softens the mist, water, moon and chill in the poem. When transferring the approach to a rainy-night photograph, retain the original darks and reduce the area of bright warmth.

visible_poem_credit.en: Bai Juyi · Tang dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 桃粉几乎铺满全幅，青绿寺顶因此成为唯一明显的冷色锚点；曲折石阶把一个小人物带入花海。成功处是以“长路＋小人”表现抵达与发现，而不只是陈列漂亮花树。花海内部仍有深浅层次、黑枝骨架和白色空隙；复用时要保留主路和主体周围的呼吸空间。
focus.en: Peach pink nearly fills the frame, making the blue-green temple roof the only clear cool-colored anchor. Winding steps lead a small figure into the sea of blossoms. The success lies in using a long path and a small person to express arrival and discovery, rather than merely displaying beautiful flowering trees. The blossom field still has value layers, a framework of black branches and white gaps; when reusing the approach, retain breathing room around the main path and subject.

visible_poem_credit.zh: 唐·张继（图中文字；非插画作者署名）
visible_poem_credit.en: Zhang Ji · Tang dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 朱红树海和米白江面形成最大尺度的分区，青绿寺顶与船上小灯是两个较小的焦点；船、码头和水纹让停泊关系成立。画面以红枫和寺院强化秋意与地点线索，但月落、霜气与夜泊的感受较弱，色彩更偏热烈。若追求清寒夜色，可用冷灰暗面收敛红色，把暖灯留作小面积亮点。
focus.en: The sea of vermilion trees and ivory river establish the largest divisions; the blue-green temple roof and small boat lamp provide two smaller focal points. Boat, landing and water lines make the mooring relationship clear. Red maples and the temple strengthen autumnal and location clues, but the sensations of a setting moon, frost and mooring at night are weaker; the color is more exuberant. For a chilly night mood, use cool gray darks to restrain the red, reserving the warm lamp as a small bright accent.

visible_poem_credit.en: Yang Wanli · Song dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 蜻蜓停在尖细卷荷上，画面抓住了“才露／早有”的短暂时刻；大片前景荷叶与小小水珠让观看转向近处。亭角退在左上，水面留白承托这一个动作，图文关系在本组中尤其清楚。放大的蜻蜓与卷荷属于插画的焦点安排；复用重点是把真实观察到的细小动作画清楚，不机械复制宏大建筑。
focus.en: The dragonfly resting on a pointed rolled lotus leaf captures the fleeting moment when the leaf has only just emerged and a dragonfly has already arrived. Large foreground leaves and a tiny droplet turn attention toward the near view. The pavilion corner recedes to the upper left, while open water supports this single action; the relationship between text and image is especially clear within the group. The enlarged dragonfly and rolled leaf are choices for focusing the illustration. The reusable lesson is to show a small action actually observed in real life clearly, not mechanically copy grand architecture.

visible_poem_credit.en: Ye Shaoweng · Song dynasty (text in the image; not the illustrator’s signature)

focus.zh: 白墙是一条连续的浅色斜带，也是园内外的界限；红花枝越过墙头，恰好把“关不住”变成可以看见的方向。门外人物与关闭的门补充了“未能入园”的情境。适合学习者学习的是让一个动作关系承载意思：越过、探出、靠近，而非只堆花草；花枝跨界的位置比花朵数量更重要。
focus.en: The white wall is a continuous pale diagonal band and also the boundary between inside and outside the garden. A red flowering branch crosses its top, turning the idea of something that cannot be contained into a visible direction. The person outside and the closed gate add the situation of being unable to enter. The learner can study how one action relationship—crossing over, reaching out or approaching—carries meaning, instead of merely piling up plants. Where the branch crosses the boundary matters more than the number of blossoms.

text.zh: 河流、村路、石阶间空地或墙面连成贯穿画幅的浅色通道；大片留白本身就是主形。植被细节集中于两侧，常以折线或 S 形引导视线。留白并非什么都不画，少量水纹、落花和倒影足以提示材质。
text.en: Rivers, village roads, gaps around stone steps and wall surfaces connect into pale passages running through the frame; large open areas are themselves major shapes. Plant detail concentrates on both sides, often guiding the eye along angular or S-shaped routes. Open space does not mean drawing nothing: a few water lines, fallen petals and reflections can suggest materials.

text.zh: 多数图采用偏高视点，屋顶、台阶、树冠与水岸逐层重叠；清楚的大小差异、遮挡和斜向边线建立纵深。空间同时保留平面装饰感；《小池》转为贴近荷叶的特写，是系列中的尺度变化，不必强求所有照片都改成俯视。
text.en: Most images use a relatively high viewpoint, with roofs, steps, canopies and banks overlapping in successive layers. Clear size differences, overlaps and diagonal edges establish depth. Space retains a flat decorative quality at the same time. Small Pond shifts to a close-up near the lotus leaves, varying the series’ scale; there is no need to force every photograph into a view from above.

text.zh: 先看见团块树冠和深色分枝，再看见密集的叶点、碎边与细小亮斑。点粒随树冠分区改变深浅，黑枝保持连贯，让“密”仍有结构；砖瓦、石阶、栏杆和荷脉则以较清楚的细线说明形体。
text.en: Massed canopies and dark branching structures register first, followed by dense leaf dots, broken edges and tiny highlights. Dots vary in value across canopy divisions, while continuous black branches keep the density structured. Bricks and tiles, steps, railings and lotus veins use clearer fine lines to describe form.

text.zh: 米白纸地承担河水、道路或天空感；墨青绿稳定大面积，瓦青与朱红组成冷暖对照。雪景收敛为蓝灰、近黑与米白，桃花图让粉色占主导，荷塘以绿调配少量红。迁移时选择一组变体，避免把所有颜色平均铺满。
text.en: An ivory paper-like ground suggests rivers, roads or sky. Dark blue-green stabilizes large areas, while tile turquoise and vermilion create warm–cool contrast. Snow scenes reduce the palette to blue-gray, near-black and ivory; pink dominates the peach-blossom image; pond scenes pair greens with a little red. Choose one variation for style transfer rather than spreading all colors evenly everywhere.

text.zh: 建筑和枝干边缘相对明确，树冠边缘则由点簇打散；哑光色面、细颗粒和略有起伏的纸色共同形成印刷插画般观感。这里描述的是可见效果，不把“纸本”“版画感”写成已核实的材质或制作工艺。
text.en: Building and branch edges are relatively definite, while clusters of dots break up canopy edges. Matte color areas, fine grain and slight variations in paper-like tone combine into the appearance of printed illustration. These are visible effects: “paper-like” and “printmaking-like” do not establish a verified material or production process.

text.zh: 渔者垂钓、牧童指路、燕子飞行、旅人登阶、蜻蜓落在荷尖、花枝越墙，都是可一眼读懂的动作。人物通常很小，物件关系却清楚；画面焦点由动作、位置和局部色差决定，未必是面积最大的建筑。
text.en: A person fishing, a herder pointing the way, swallows flying, a traveler climbing steps, a dragonfly resting on a lotus tip and a flowering branch crossing a wall are all actions readable at a glance. Figures are usually small, yet object relationships remain clear. Action, position and local color contrast determine the focus, which need not be the largest building.

text.zh: 大标题压在深色树冠上，细竖排诗句放在浅色空地里，红色印章形成小面积节奏；字与图共同分配疏密。原附件保留全部题字与印章。照片改绘默认只借用绘画语言；另做诗词海报时，先安排文字位置，再用排版工具加入核对过的诗文。
text.en: Large titles sit over dark canopies, fine vertical verses occupy pale open areas and red seals create small rhythmic accents. Text and image distribute density together. All inscriptions and seals in the original attachments are retained. By default, photo reinterpretation borrows only the painting language. For a separate poetry poster, plan text placement first, then add verified verses with a layout tool.

text.zh: 《江雪》的少色与独舟、《小池》的卷荷与蜻蜓、《游园不值》的越墙花枝，图像与所题诗句的关系最清楚。《乌衣巷》的华丽门第、《枫桥夜泊》的大面积暖红和亮地，则更强调装饰与地标，清寒、夜色或今昔之感相对弱。以上是本次品鉴判断；复用前先决定自己真正要表达的感受。
text.en: River Snow’s limited colors and solitary boat, Small Pond’s rolled lotus leaf and dragonfly, and An Unsuccessful Visit to a Garden’s branch crossing the wall have the clearest relationships to their inscribed verses. Wuyi Lane’s lavish residence and Night Mooring by Maple Bridge’s broad warm reds and bright ground emphasize decoration and landmarks more, with relatively less chill, night atmosphere or contrast between past and present. These are judgments from this appreciation exercise; before reusing the approach, decide what feeling you actually want to express.

legacy_prompts.zh: 将输入照片完整改绘为具有古诗意境的新中式装饰山水插画，参考本组的细线勾勒、团簇树冠、哑光色块、纸本颗粒与连续留白。照片决定内容、构图、视角和画幅，参考图只提供视觉语言。保留主体数量、人物身份与表情、动作、原有衣着、物件关系、建筑和地形结构、前后遮挡及原始比例；不要把现代场景替换成古代。沿照片已有的河道、小径、天空、地面或墙面组织较安静的浅色区域，以两侧已有的植被和建筑形成疏密对照；如果原图没有贯通通道，就保留原有空隙，不另造河流或道路。先把树冠与叶簇归纳为清楚的大色团，再用近黑的分枝、细密但分区有序的叶点、碎边和少量亮斑建立层次；砖瓦、石阶、栏杆、叶脉以节制细线表达。减少摄影式光滑渐变，保留必要明暗与空间重叠，整幅统一为绘画语言。按原照片的季节、光线和情绪选一组色彩：常态用米纸白、墨青绿与瓦青，少量朱砂红作焦点；冬景改用蓝灰、近黑与米白；花海可用桃粉主调和少量青绿；荷塘以深浅绿配少量红。不要为配色凭空添加雪、红叶、花朵、灯笼或改变天气。让原有的一个小动作或观察成为故事焦点，在人物面部、手和关键物件附近减少纹理，保持清楚可辨；明暗与色彩强度服从要表达的感受。水面只用疏朗细纹和概括倒影提示质感，纸面颗粒轻薄，不覆盖细节。不强制改为俯视或狭长竖幅，不导入参考中的寺庙、酒楼、舟船、牧童、燕子、蜻蜓或古装人物，不新增诗句、标题、印章、签名、边框和水印。避免均匀噪点、荧光色、厚重油画堆积、写实 3D、摄影贴片及仅加调色滤镜。
legacy_prompts.en: Repaint the entire input photograph as a contemporary Chinese-style decorative landscape illustration with the atmosphere of classical Chinese poetry, borrowing the visual language of these references: fine contour drawing, clustered tree canopies, matte color fields, subtle paper grain and connected areas of open space. Let the photograph determine content, composition, viewpoint and frame; use the references only for visual language. Preserve subject count, recognizable identities and expressions, actions, existing clothing, object relationships, architecture, terrain, occlusion and proportions; do not replace a contemporary scene with an ancient one. Use existing water, paths, sky, ground or walls as calmer light areas, framed by vegetation and architecture already present. If the input has no continuous passage, keep its existing gaps instead of inventing a river or road. Establish broad, readable canopy masses first, then articulate them with near-black branching structures, regionally organized leaf stippling, broken edges and restrained highlights. Describe brickwork, roof tiles, stone steps, railings and leaf veins with economical fine lines. Reduce smooth photographic gradients while retaining necessary shading, overlap and readable depth in a consistent illustrated treatment. Choose one palette variant to suit the actual season, light and mood: warm paper ivory, deep blue-green and turquoise with limited vermilion accents; blue-gray, near-black and ivory for a winter scene; peach-pink masses with small blue-green accents for blossom scenes; or layered greens with sparse red for a lotus pond. Do not invent snow, red foliage, flowers or lanterns, or change the weather to force a palette. Let one existing small action or observed detail carry the story. Reduce texture near faces, hands and important objects so they remain legible, and let contrast and color intensity serve the intended feeling. Suggest water only with sparse fine ripples and simplified reflections; keep paper grain light and subtle so it does not cover details. Do not force an elevated viewpoint or a narrow vertical crop. Do not import temples, taverns, boats, young herders, swallows, dragonflies or figures in historical dress from the references. Add no poem, title, seal, signature, border or watermark. Avoid uniform visual noise, fluorescent color, heavy impasto, realistic 3D, photographic patches and color filtering without redrawing.

observed_avoid.zh: 避免只套青绿滤镜、把每片叶子画成等量噪点，或为模仿竖幅海报强行裁成狭长画面。不要让满幅红花和灯火压过本来想表达的安静与清寒；不要把现代真实场景全部替换成古建筑。诗句中的人物、物件和节令关系需要有意识选择，不能靠贴一首诗替代画面表达。
observed_avoid.en: Avoid merely applying a blue-green filter, turning every leaf into the same amount of noise, or forcing a narrow crop to imitate vertical posters. Do not let red flowers and lantern light across the image overwhelm the intended quiet and chill, or replace an entire real contemporary scene with historical buildings. Relationships among the poems’ figures, objects and seasons require deliberate choices; placing a poem on an image cannot substitute for visual expression.

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
